data.name: 99Managers Futsal Edition
data.detailed_description:
99Managers is a sports management game, and this is the Futsal Edition, the first in the series.

Run real futsal matches with a real-time 2D match engine, then take full control with an in-game editor. Customize players, teams, and competitions. And since it’s open source, you can get the full source code and make it yours.

2D match engine

- Watch full matches or just the highlights

- Influence outcomes by changing players and tactics

- Simulate matches and get final results instantly

Data pack editor

- Create custom data packs and share them with others

- Customize competitions, and build your own leagues and cups

- Create teams, use logos, and edit player attributes

Join the community

- Because your feedback matters

- Report bugs

- Improve translations

- Contribute fixes and features

Made with Godot Engine 4 and much love.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: On-Chip GPU
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Quad Core processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
